subject: MAP kickoff: SynergiHealth - Redwood MAP draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@synergihealth.com>, Mia Chen <mia.chen@synergihealth.com>, David Collins <david.collins@synergihealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: SynergiHealth - Redwood MAP draft

Hi Alex / Mia / David

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I've put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close window. The goal is to make responsibilities and timeline explicit so we can track toward a Q2 contract decision.

Attached: SynergiHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx (initial draft) - highlights inside, but quick summary below:

Proposed milestones / timeline (draft):
- Discovery complete / technical deep-dive: by 2026-03-18 (Owner: Synergi technical/Aditya)
- Security review & evidence (SOC2, network requirements): by 2026-03-25 (Owner: Synergi security/David)
- Pilot / PoC (2 weeks): 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-14 (Owner: Synergi + Redwood delivery)
- Procurement & contract review: by 2026-04-22 (Owner: Synergi procurement/Mia)
- Final sign & go-live target: 2026-05-01 (Target close)

Key responsibilities / dependencies:
- Redwood: delivery plan, MAP, SOC2 artifact package, pilot environment (staging), SE support (Aditya).
- Synergi: internal stakeholders confirmed, procurement timeline, test data access/PII scoping, network/VPN steps.
- Dependencies: timely access to test data, completion of security questionnaire, procurement windows (finance/contract review).

Two timeline options I want to propose (pick one or propose alternatives):
A) Aggressive: target close by 2026-04-15 - requires security questionnaire completed by 2026-03-18 and procurement prioritized.
B) Standard: target close by 2026-05-01 - allows two-week internal procurement review and slightly longer pilot.

Ask: Please confirm the primary stakeholders for each milestone (technical, security, procurement) and which timeline option you prefer. If you want, I can update the attached MAP with names/ownership and share a version in Drive.

Next steps I'll take from Redwood side:
- Share MAP in Drive and update after your confirmation (link below).
- Aditya to schedule technical deep-dive once stakeholders are confirmed.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bSynergi-Map-Draft
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/2026-D-01134

Thanks - looking forward to locking in owners and timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: SynergiHealth - Redwood MAP draft

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the clear MAP draft and for pulling this together so quickly. Useful starting point. A few quick notes from our side:

- Stakeholders:
  - Technical owner: Alex Turner (me) and I'll loop in our data platform lead (R. Patel) for the deep dive.
  - Security owner: David Collins (CISO) - he's flagged a tight schedule for collecting SOC2 evidence; he asked if Redwood can provide the SOC2 binder and a short list of required artifacts.
  - Procurement: Mia Chen (Procurement Lead), she's copied.

- Timeline: We prefer Option B (target close 2026-05-01). Our procurement cycle likely won't support mid-April signature.

- Dependencies: We will need a short list of required test data fields and a description of the network/VPN setup you'll need. Can Aditya share a short tech checklist?

I've attached a quick one-page with feedback and suggested minor edits to the MAP.

Can we do a follow-up 30-min call next week (Tue or Wed)? Prefer Tue 3/10 in the afternoon PST.

Thanks - Alex

Great - thanks for the quick reply and the edits, Alex.

I've updated the MAP with your feedback (I'll upload v1.1 to Drive once we confirm stakeholders). Based on your note, we'll proceed with Option B (target close 2026-05-01). I've also captured the items you asked for:

Action items from Redwood (assignments):
- Provide SOC2 binder + list of required security artifacts: Marissa (by 2026-03-06)
- Tech checklist (test data fields, network/VPN notes): Aditya (by 2026-03-09)
- Schedule technical deep-dive: Aditya + Alex - propose Tue 2026-03-10 3:00 PM PST or Wed 2026-03-11 10:00 AM PST; please confirm preferred slot.

From Synergi side (please confirm):
- Confirm technical lead for the deep-dive (name/email) - Alex, you mentioned R. Patel; if you can share direct contact that's great.
- Confirm procurement timeline and any blackout dates Mia we should be aware of.

I'll attach the updated MAP and link in Drive once I get your confirmation on stakeholders and the call slot.

If that all looks good, I'll update the HubSpot deal with the MAP milestones so we have visibility on our side.

Best,
